subject: LedgerWorks: Account-level incident accountability package and verification steps
messages:
--- Message 1 ---
From: Chris Taylor <chris.taylor@ledgerworks.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Aug 4 latency spike — request for details and validation steps

Hi Grace,

Our platform saw a series of elevated tail-latency spikes against the Redwood inference endpoints on Aug 4 between ~16:43-17:12 UTC. Our SREs flagged increased token timeouts and a small number of 5xx responses. Can you provide a consolidated summary of what happened, root cause, and the specific mitigations you applied? We need:

- A brief RCA we can share with our internal ops and security teams.
- A timeline of events and configuration changes.
- A short checklist we can run to validate the fixes on our side.

We're preparing an incident review with our engineering leadership on Monday and would like to include Redwood's accountability package.

Thanks,
Chris
Chris Taylor
Head of Platform, LedgerWorks

--- Message 2 ---
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Chris Taylor <chris.taylor@ledgerworks.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-05T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aug 4 latency spike — request for details and validation steps

Hi Chris — thanks for the note and sorry for the disruption. We own this and will deliver a concise accountability package by EOD Aug 6 PST. Quick plan:

1) Jonas will send the RCA and annotated timeline (CSV + narrative).
2) Hannah will provide the verification checklist and sanity logs you can run.
3) I'll coordinate a 30-minute follow-up call if you'd like a walk-through and to agree verification windows.

If there are specific stakeholders who should be on the verification call (security, platform), please share.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 ---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Chris Taylor <chris.taylor@ledgerworks.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-06T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: LedgerWorks — RCA and annotated timeline (Aug 4 latency surge)

Hi Chris — attaching the accountability package per Grace's note. Summary up front:

Root cause (short):
- A transient deadlock in our async token-allocator combined with an unexpected request burst pattern from a client-side retry loop. The allocator stalled under a high concurrent prefix-cache eviction rate which increased median KV fetch latency and led to timeouts in the serving runtime.

Why it impacted LedgerWorks:
- Your traffic pattern included a higher-than-normal short-sequence retry burst between 16:38–16:55 UTC that coincided with a rolling cache rebalancing job. The overlap produced sustained queue growth on a small subset of pods handling your regional shard.

Mitigations applied (timeline):
- 16:42 UTC: Anomalous alert triggered for tail-latency (> 95th p90) on the region.
- 16:44 UTC: Autoscaling added two pods to the affected pool; however, the allocator deadlock prevented those pods from contributing to requests.
- 16:50 UTC: We pushed a hotfix to the allocator to break the deadlock (v1.12.3-hotfix).
- 16:55 UTC: Rolling restart of the affected pool completed.
- 17:03 UTC: Traffic stabilized; token timeouts reduced to baseline.

Action items (owner & ETA):
- Jonas Weber: 1) Full allocator race-condition patch (v1.13.0) — ETA 2028-08-10. 2) Post-deployment canary policy updates to block overlapping rebalances during high retry bursts — ETA 2028-08-09.
- Hannah Schmitt: 1) Customer-facing verification checklist + logs to validate mitigation — delivered in separate email. 2) Add a specific alert for cache rebalances overlapping client retry spikes — ETA 2028-08-12.
- Marissa Cole: 1) Contract-level credit review for impacted window (internal finance coordination) — ETA 2028-08-11.

Attachments: timeline-20280805.csv (annotated events), rfc-action-items.pdf (detailed owner plan), sanity-check-logs.tar.gz (redacted logs and traces).

On Mon, Aug 5, 2028 at 11:05 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Chris — thanks for the note and sorry for the disruption. We own this and will deliver a concise accountability package by EOD Aug 6 PST.

Please let me know if you want a short walkthrough on Tuesday.

Best,
Jonas
Principal Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

--- Message 4 ---
From: Chris Taylor <chris.taylor@ledgerworks.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@ledgerworks.com>, Sandra Lin <sandra.lin@ledgerworks.com>
Date: 2028-08-06T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LedgerWorks — RCA and annotated timeline (Aug 4 latency surge)

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifying items: 

1) For the verification checklist, can you include the exact queries/requests we should run (headers, example payloads) and the expected response latencies?
2) For the rolling restart you performed, can you confirm whether any sessions were dropped and whether KV cache warmup was required post-restart?

We'll plan to run the customer-side verification tomorrow morning. If you can provide a short window for a joint verification test (30 minutes), that would be helpful.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Chris

--- Message 5 ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Chris Taylor <chris.taylor@ledgerworks.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-07T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Accountability package + customer verification checklist (LedgerWorks)

Hi Chris — attaching the verification checklist and the quick validation playbook. Key points:

- Expected behaviour after the v1.12.3-hotfix and allocator patch: token-level latencies should be within your baseline (median token time < 45ms; 95th < 220ms) for the sample payloads we provided.
- Sessions: the rolling restart did not drop client-level sessions; we used in-place connection draining. Some KV cache warm-up occurred on warmed pods — warm-up period ~2m per pod under your traffic profile.

Quick verification checklist (high level):
1) Run sample payload A (attached) 100x at 10 rps from your staging node — expect median token <45ms and <1% 5xx.
2) Run sample payload B (long-sequence) 50x at 5 rps — confirm no token timeouts.
3) During the test window, enable debug token tracing for 10 minutes and share the trace ids back to us for cross-check (instructions in the checklist).
4) We will run a simultaneous canary on one serving pool to validate that your observed metrics match ours.

Proposed verification slots (PST): Aug 8 — 09:00–09:30, 11:00–11:30. Please confirm preferred slot and which contact will own the run.

Attachments included: rfc-action-items.pdf, timeline-20280805.csv, sanity-check-logs.tar.gz

If everything checks out we will follow with the formal postmortem document and our deployment of v1.13.0.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--- End of thread ---
